handoff.purpose: Implements patch artifact capture, post-gate verification, gate running, and artifact persistence.

symbols.name: _capture_patch_artifact
symbols.note: Stages worktree, computes diff, returns PatchArtifact with diff_bytes, diff_sha256, changed_paths.

symbols.name: _post_gate_artifact_stable
symbols.note: Compares post-gate diff SHA256 and tree state to artifact; returns (True, '') if unchanged, else (False, error string).

symbols.name: _run_gates
symbols.note: Calls self._gate(ctx), catches exceptions, returns GateResult with duration.

symbols.name: _persist
symbols.note: Compatibility wrapper that calls _persist_to_store and extracts blob_path or error.

symbols.name: _persist_to_store
symbols.note: Persists artifact to content-addressed store; docstring warns about caller-chosen path.

observations.what: _capture_patch_artifact calls _git with add -A, then diff --cached and diff --name-only -z; returns PatchArtifact.
_post_gate_artifact_stable compares cached diff SHA256 to artifact.diff_sha256; also checks for unstaged and untracked files. Returns (False, error) on mismatch.
_run_gates calls self._gate(ctx) and catches Exception, returning GateResult with duration.
_persist is a compatibility wrapper that calls _persist_to_store and extracts blob_path.
_persist_to_store is a stub with a detailed docstring but no implementation body visible in this chunk (truncated).
Docstring of _persist_to_store contains extensive claims about past security issues and current safeguards; many are uncheckable due to missing context.
